description: Adjusts an amount (rent, salary, contract price) from one month to another by Statistics Norway's consumer price index: amount × index(to) / index(from). Costs 0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Base). Errors are free.

from.description: The month the amount was set, YYYY-MM. Required.

to.description: The month to adjust to, YYYY-MM. Default: the latest month.

name: adjust_by_cpi
title: Index-adjust an amount by the CPI
